mechanism_narrative: A persistently low federal funds rate (below 0.5%) indicates accommodative monetary policy that reduces the cost of capital for corporations, leading to higher equity valuations and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in the unemployment rate exceeding 0.5 percentage points signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the UNRATE trigger is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) are rising above their 3-month moving average while industrial production (INDPRO) is falling below its 3-month moving average, it indicates a fragmented economic recovery where strong consumer demand is not supported by production capacity, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where HOUST > 3mo MA and INDPRO < 3mo MA, or the Rank IC for the interaction signal is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In the early stages of an economic recovery (when quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) turns positive from negative and retail sales (RSAFS) are rising), the market anticipates improving corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 growth turns positive and RSAFS is rising, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average indicates strengthening manufacturing activity, which boosts corporate profits and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO is above its 6-month MA, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly year-over-year increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeding 2.5% signals rising inflation that may prompt the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC for the CPI trigger is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a labor market tightness regime (when monthly payroll growth (PAYEMS) exceeds 100k and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5.0%), strong employment conditions support consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 100k and UNRATE < 5.0%, or the Rank IC for the joint condition is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is at or below 0.5% and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 9.0%, it indicates a weak economy with aggressive monetary easing, which typically fails to stimulate growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS <= 0.5% and UNRATE > 9.0%, or the Rank IC for the interaction is below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.
